summary.text: Travis Wilson is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 106 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career has been in economic development for the cities of St. Charles and Florissant.

paragraphs.text: Wilson was born in Creve Coeur, Missouri, lives in Saint Charles, and graduated from Francis Howell North High School in 2001.
He earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from the University of Missouri, St. Louis, in 2009.

His career experience includes working in economic development with the City of St. Charles and the City of Florissant, and he joined the Saint Charles County Association of Realtors, the Missouri Economic Development Council, the Heartland Regional Investment Fund and the Hawthorn Foundation.
Wilson first took office on January 4, 2023.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Economic Development Committee and served as vice chair of the Commerce Committee.
